reason: Provides durable, normalized CI execution metadata to an agent by reading an allowlist of environment variables and injecting changed snapshots; it does not control pipelines, read logs, or write repositories.

summaries.zh: 将来自 GitHub Actions、GitLab CI 或通用 CI 环境的规范化执行元数据注入智能体上下文，并对未变化的快照去重。
summaries.en: Injects normalized execution metadata from GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or generic CI environments into agent context while deduplicating unchanged snapshots.

capabilities: Reads an allowlist of CI environment metadata
Detects GitHub Actions and GitLab CI execution context
Injects normalized CI metadata into agent context
